titulo: Does a microwave cook from the inside out? 🍲 #howitworks #shorts
descripcion:
Microwaves don't cook from the inside out. They make water molecules spin billions of times a second, and only about an inch deep.

What should we explain next?

#howitworks #microwave #science #engineering #physics #shorts

lineas.texto: Does your microwave really cook food from the inside out?
Nope. What it actually does is way weirder.
Hidden on the side, a part called a magnetron fires invisible waves into the box.
They bounce off the metal walls, back and forth, straight through your food.
Every water molecule has a positive end and a negative end, so it lines up with the wave.
But the wave flips direction billions of times a second, so the water keeps spinning back and forth.
All that spinning and bumping is heat.
And the waves only reach about an inch in. The middle cooks from heat spreading inward.
The holes in the door are way smaller than the waves, so they can't escape. But light can, so you can watch.
Now you know. What should we explain next?
